coords: normalised 0-1, origin top-left of the frame
note: explode.frames[j].anchors are the 2D anchor points of each labelled part in explode frame j; labels are meant to be shown on the last (fully exploded) frame. rotate anchors are informational (visible=false means occluded at that angle).

parts.name: Heat Spreader
parts.description: Two brushed metal covers that clip over both sides of the module, protecting the chips and spreading their heat out to the air.

parts.name: Thermal Pads
parts.description: Soft pads between the chips and the spreader that fill the tiny air gaps so heat can flow into the metal.

parts.name: DRAM Chips
parts.description: The memory chips that hold your data while the PC is running. They sit on both sides of the board.

parts.name: PCB
parts.description: The green circuit board that connects every memory chip to the contacts along the bottom edge.

parts.name: SPD Chip
parts.description: A tiny chip that tells the motherboard how the module is set up, so the system can configure it at boot.

parts.name: Gold Edge Contacts
parts.description: The row of gold-plated fingers that press into the motherboard's memory slot to carry power and signals.

parts.name: Key Notch
parts.description: An off-centre gap in the contact edge that matches the ridge in the slot, so the module only fits one way round.
